qualification.details: President: Doctorate in the area of physical sciences/chemical sciences/life sciences/any other related interdisciplinary area. At least 25 years of experience in R&D in industrial and academic institutions and/or Science and Technology organizations or as faculty/scientist of recognized national/international universities/research institutes/corporate R&D Labs etc., out of which 6 years should be in managerial/administrative capacity for Science & Technology programmes, planning and development, budget & finance, coordination and such organization matters. This shall also include minimum 10 years of experience as Professor in a University system or ten years of experience in an equivalent position in a reputed research and/or academic administrative organization. R & D experience in the domain areas of research/activities undertaken by the institute such as physical sciences/ chemical sciences/life sciences/any other related interdisciplinary area. R & D experience will include the Ph.D period.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for JNCASR President Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.jncasr.ac.in.

Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for JNCASR President Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.jncasr.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JNCASR President post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the President post at JNCASR is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the President position?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Doctorate in physical sciences, chemical sciences, life sciences, or any related interdisciplinary area. A minimum of 25 years of R&D experience is also required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the President post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the President position is not exceeding 60 years as of July 01, 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the President role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 2,25,000/- per month as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the JNCASR President recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline. Download the form from the official website, fill it correctly, and send it by post to the Administrative Officer, JNCASR, Bengaluru.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies for the President post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy for the post of President at JNCASR.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a deputation job opportunity at JNCASR.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the President post?
faq.answer: The selection will be made through a Search-cum-Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of JNCASR, which is www.jncasr.ac.in.
